business_objective: Release completed service documents to applicants or their named authorized collectors and close each request after acknowledged handover.

stakeholder_statements.text: An applicant submits a collection request for a completed service document and names an authorized collector when someone else will collect it.
The records clerk confirms that the document is ready and checks whether the person collecting it is the applicant or the named authorized collector.
An authorized collector provides the collection reference and acknowledges receipt when the document is handed over.
The counter officer records which document was handed over and who collected it.
The service supervisor closes the collection request only after receipt is acknowledged. Application assessment and document delivery by mail are outside this project.

business_objective: Record trailer-seal custody and verify seal condition and identity from dispatch through arrival.

stakeholder_statements.text: The dispatch loader records the trailer identifier and the seal identifier before loading is released.
The dispatch supervisor confirms that the trailer doors are closed and authorizes departure.
The driver checks that the recorded seal identifier matches the seal on the trailer and records the result before leaving.
At arrival, the receiving clerk records whether the seal is intact and whether the seal identifier matches the dispatch record.
The receiving supervisor closes the transfer record only after the arrival checks are recorded. Route planning and freight billing are outside this project.

business_objective: Coordinate non-clinical accessibility support requested for scheduled appointments and communicate support readiness.

stakeholder_statements.text: A client requests an appointment and describes the accessibility support needed during the visit.
The scheduling agent links the support request to the appointment and routes it to the accessibility coordinator. The support categories have not been agreed.
The accessibility coordinator assigns a service assistant or records that support is unavailable. The assignment rule is still undecided.
The service assistant records that the requested support has been prepared and may add a preparation note.

The scheduling agent sends the support-readiness outcome to the client before the appointment. The delivery channel is undecided, and clinical treatment and transport booking are outside this project.

business_objective: Review requests to defer planned maintenance tasks and preserve the applicable schedule based on the review outcome.

stakeholder_statements.text: An asset owner requests a deferral for a planned maintenance task and explains the operational reason.
The maintenance planner records the current planned date and the proposed new date, then checks whether dependent work is affected. The dependency types are not finalized.

The risk reviewer records a risk category and records the deferral as accepted or rejected. The reviewer also records any operating condition required during the delay. The risk categories are still undecided.
When the deferral is accepted, the schedule coordinator updates the maintenance task to the approved new date.
When the deferral is rejected, the maintenance planner keeps the current planned date and records the rejection reason. Performing the maintenance task and purchasing parts are outside this project.

business_objective: Review residential sublet requests using completeness, property-condition, compliance, and final-decision inputs while preserving an unresolved advertising rule.

stakeholder_statements.text: A tenant submits a sublet request, identifies the proposed occupant, and states the requested sublet period.
The leasing officer checks whether the request is complete and says the tenant may advertise the unit after that preliminary check. The required supporting documents are not finalized.
The property inspector records whether the unit condition permits the proposed occupancy and adds inspection comments.
The compliance reviewer says the unit must not be advertised until final approval is recorded. The reviewer records a compliance decision and any occupancy restrictions.

The property manager records the final approval or decline after the inspection and compliance inputs are present. Nobody has decided who verifies the proposed occupant's identity or how quickly the decision must be issued. Rent collection and lease renewal are outside this project, and the team also argued about the hallway paint.
